Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Contract
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Roslin – Building the Future of Transportation Technology 
 At Roslin, we build cutting-edge platforms and solutions for the transportation industry, powering everything from real-time fleet tracking to complete operational integration for the US market. You’ll join an A+ engineering team working on a world-class product suite built on a best-in-class stack. We don’t just ship software - we’re building AI-native platforms with an AI-first approach across every layer of our technology.
 We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to lead infrastructure automation, platform reliability, and CI/CD excellence. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain scalable systems supporting mission-critical applications in a hybrid multi-cloud environment - directly impacting how thousands of users experience our services every day. This is a role for an engineer (not just a coder) who cares about reliability, automation depth, and long-term operability of complex systems.
 Key Responsibilities 
Collaborate with Engineering to deploy new services.
Plan & execute an architecture that deploys our SaaS as an instance across multiple clouds and platform versions.
Design, implement, and maintain private cloud infrastructure using IaC tools (e.g., Terraform).
Manage container orchestration with Kubernetes and Docker .
Build & maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or Cloud Build).
Automate deployments across dev, staging, QA and production.
Deploy comprehensive monitoring & alerting; implement New Relic and wire alerting.
Perform RCA for production incidents; resolve complex technical issues.
Design & implement system troubleshooting and maintenance procedures.
Write automation scripts ( Python , Bash , PowerShell , Go ) to reduce manual work.
Build tools to minimize errors and improve customer experience.
Automate provisioning and configuration management; maintain deployment automation across environments.
Provide L2/L3 technical support.
Partner with development teams to understand application architecture & operational requirements
Document solutions; train operational teams on supportability.
Contribute to project planning and strategic technology decisions.
Implement AI automations within CI/CD pipelines.
Implement SOC 2 controls and compliance automation.
Optimize cloud spend and guide teams in designing cost-efficient architectures and applying best practices.
 What We’re Looking For 
 🛠 Technical Skills 
 5+ years DevOps/SRE with Bachelor's Degree (or 2+ with Master’s/MBA ; or PhD with relevant experience ).
 CI/CD: GCP Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, Terraform (or similar).
 Containers: Deep knowledge of Docker & Kubernetes.
 Linux: Advanced administration & shell scripting.
 Networking: Load balancing, HA, VPC, NAT, Cloud Armor.
 IaC: Terraform (or similar).
 Cloud Architecture: Private & hybrid cloud; cost optimization.
 🏅 Nice to have 
 Golang (Go) proficiency
Relevant Google Cloud certifications (e.g., Cloud DevOps Engineer, Cloud Architect, or similar) .
 📈 Relevant Experience 
Multi-cloud SaaS instance deployment & versioning.
Infra provisioning & config management automation.
Monitoring/alerting & incident response (New Relic or similar).
Troubleshooting distributed systems in production.
Security best practices; SOC 2 control implementation & automation.
Operating mission-critical, high-uptime environments.
Experience with ERP domain is considered a plus
 🤝 Soft Skills 
Fluent English (written & spoken).
Analytical, proactive, detail-oriented.
Strong problem-solving skills under pressure (especially during incidents).
Clear and concise communication of technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Continuous improvement & automation-first mindset.
 What We Offer 
 💰 Competitive compensation based on impact
 📄 Official Employment
 🏙️ Work model: On-site from Bucharest 
 🗓️ Work at your best - select from 10–7 , 11–8, 12-9, 13-10 and keep your work-life balance in check.
 🏢 Brand-new office in Bucharest 
 👨 Fully in-house engineering (no outsourcing/outstaffing)
 🚄 Opportunity to work on high-impact, mission-critical projects for the US market from day one.
 🚀 Career growth & skill development: clear ownership areas, senior mentorship, and opportunities to broaden scope across SRE, platform, and security.
 Join us in redefining how transportation technology operates at scale. At Roslin, the systems you build won’t just deploy apps - they’ll power industries and connect millions! 
 📧 Hit Apply and fill in application form - your next challenge starts here!
